mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku(sku_id, stock_quantity, price_at_sku, created_at) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{stockQuantity}, #{priceAtSku}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT s.sku_id AS skuId, s.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, s.price_at_sku AS priceAtSku, s.created_at AS createdAt, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(po.option_name, ':', pov.option_value) ORDER BY po.option_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS optionSummary FROM sku s JOIN option_value_sku ovs ON ovs.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id WHERE po.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY s.sku_id, s.stock_quantity, s.price_at_sku, s.created_at ORDER BY s.created_at DESC

SELECT pov.option_value_id AS optionId, po.product_id AS productId, po.option_name AS optionName, pov.option_value AS optionValue FROM option_value_sku ovs JOIN product_option_value pov ON pov.option_value_id = ovs.option_value_id JOIN product_option po ON po.option_id = pov.option_id WHERE ovs.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY po.option_name, pov.sort_order, pov.option_value
